Homebrew: activating this triggers casting the automated Spine Rake (Sea Serpent) spell — same "Activate → Cast a Spell → Effect: you cast X" pattern used for this character's other homebrew battle-form abilities.

Activate 2 (move)

Effect You extend your spines and Swim or Stride; you cast @UUID[Compendium.phil-pf2e-weredragon.weredragon-feats.Item.Spine Rake (Sea Serpent)] to resolve the damage and save against each creature you're adjacent to during that movement.
